hero.title: Mebix
hero.description: App for people with type 2 diabetes
hero.tagline: Mobile app that helps people with type 2 diabetes manage nutrition and therapy. AI food recognition from photos, daily tasks, educational content from doctors.

seo.title: Mebix — diabetes app on React Native
seo.description: Mobile development for Mebix: AI food recognition, nutrition tracking, medical guidance.

overview.title: About the project
overview.description: Mebix is a German app for people with type 2 diabetes (Vision2B GmbH). Helps control nutrition, track therapy, and learn to manage the condition. Registered as a class I medical device under MDR.

solution.title: What was built
solution.description: React Native mobile app for iOS and Android. Key features:

features.title: AI food recognition
features.description: User takes a photo of a meal — AI identifies food items and calculates nutritional value. Portions can be adjusted manually; personalized nutrition recommendations follow.

features.title: Daily tasks
features.description: Color-coded bars on the home screen: medication, activity, glucose check, nutrition. Completed tasks disappear — no bars means the day is done.

features.title: Educational videos
features.description: Short films from diabetologists and cardiologists on therapy, nutrition, and physical activity. Delivered step by step.

results.title: Clinical results
results.description: Mebix effectiveness is backed by two clinical studies in Germany.
